privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: WearTry ("we", "us", "our") operates weartry.shop. This policy explains what personal information we collect when you visit our site or place an order, and how we use, store, and protect it.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: When you browse our site, place an order, or contact us, we may collect:
list: Name, email address, phone number
Shipping and billing address
Order history and preferences
Payment confirmation details (we never see or store your full card number — payments are processed directly by our payment provider)
Basic technical data such as IP address and browser type, for security and site performance purposes

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect to:
list: Process and fulfil your orders, including shipping and customs documentation
Communicate with you about your order status, shipping updates, and customer support requests
Improve our website and product range
Send occasional marketing updates, only if you have opted in — you can unsubscribe at any time

sections.heading: 3. Sharing Your Information
sections.body: We share order information only with the third parties necessary to deliver your order:
list: Our payment processor, to securely process your payment
Our fulfillment and shipping partners, to deliver your order and handle customs clearance where required
Service providers who help us operate the website (e.g. hosting, email)
sections.closing: We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: 4. International Transfers
sections.body: As we ship internationally and work with partners based in different countries, your information may be transferred and processed outside your country of residence. We take reasonable steps to ensure it is handled securely and in line with this policy.

sections.heading: 5. Data Retention
sections.body: We retain order and account information for as long as necessary to fulfil orders, comply with legal and tax obligations, and resolve disputes.

sections.heading: 6. Your Rights
sections.body: You can ask us at any time to:
list: Access the personal information we hold about you
Correct inaccurate information
Delete your information, subject to legal retention requirements
Withdraw consent to marketing communications
sections.closing: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at support@weartry.shop.

sections.heading: 7. Security
sections.body: We use industry-standard measures to protect your information, including encrypted checkout and secure data storage. No online service can guarantee 100% security, but we work to keep your data safe.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top reflects the most recent revision.

sections.heading: 9. Contact Us
sections.body: Questions about this policy can be sent to support@weartry.shop.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of weartry.shop and any purchase you make through it. By placing an order, you agree to the terms below.

sections.heading: 1. About Us
sections.body: WearTry is an online clothing retailer selling apparel for men, women, and kids, shipping to customers across the United States, United Kingdom, and European Union.

sections.heading: 2. Orders and Pricing
sections.body: Prices are shown in US dollars and confirmed at checkout. We reserve the right to correct pricing errors before an order is confirmed. An order is accepted once payment has been successfully processed; we will send a confirmation email once this happens.

sections.heading: 3. Payments
sections.body: Payments are processed by our third-party payment provider. WearTry does not store your full card details. All transactions are subject to our payment provider's own verification and fraud-prevention checks, and we reserve the right to cancel and refund any order flagged as high-risk or fraudulent.

sections.heading: 4. Shipping and Customs
sections.body: We ship internationally. Delivery times and applicable customs duties or taxes vary by destination; see our Shipping Information page for details. Where required, duties and taxes are either collected at checkout or payable by the customer on delivery, depending on order value and destination.

sections.heading: 5. Returns and Refunds
sections.body: Returns and refunds are handled under our Return & Refund Policy, available on our website.

sections.heading: 6. Product Information
sections.body: We make reasonable efforts to display product colors, materials, and sizing accurately. Slight variations may occur due to screen settings or manufacturing batches.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the extent permitted by law, WearTry is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our website or products, beyond the value of the order in question.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of our site after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.heading: 9. Governing Law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws applicable to WearTry's place of business, without prejudice to any statutory consumer protection rights you may have in your own country of residence.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms can be sent to support@weartry.shop.

returns.title: Return & Refund Policy
returns.intro: We want you to love what you order. This policy explains how returns and refunds work at WearTry.

sections.heading: 1. Return Window
sections.body: You may request a return within 30 days of delivery, provided the item is unworn, unwashed, and in its original condition with tags attached.

sections.heading: 2. How to Start a Return
sections.body: Email support@weartry.shop with your order number and the item you'd like to return. We'll confirm the next steps and provide a return address.

sections.heading: 3. Refunds
sections.body: Once we receive and inspect the returned item, we'll issue a refund to your original payment method within 5–10 business days. Original shipping costs are non-refundable, and return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility unless the item was damaged, defective, or incorrect.

sections.heading: 4. Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Items
sections.body: If your order arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect, contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos of the issue. We'll arrange a replacement or full refund, including return shipping, at no extra cost to you.

sections.heading: 5. Exchanges
sections.body: We currently do not offer direct exchanges. If you'd like a different size or item, please return your original order for a refund and place a new order.

sections.heading: 6. Customs and Import Duties
sections.body: Any import duties or taxes paid on delivery are collected by your local customs authority and are not refundable by WearTry.

sections.heading: 7. Non-Returnable Items
sections.body: For hygiene reasons, items marked as final sale, or intimate apparel where applicable, cannot be returned unless faulty.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
sections.body: Questions about a return or refund can be sent to support@weartry.shop.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how WearTry uses cookies and similar technologies to recognise you when you visit our website, in line with the EU ePrivacy Directive, GDPR, and UK PECR.

sections.heading: 1. What Are Cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small data files placed on your device that help websites function properly and provide analytics and personalisation.

sections.heading: 2. Types of Cookies We Use
sections.body: Strictly necessary cookies (required for the website to function, e.g. shopping cart and checkout), performance and analytics cookies (help us understand how visitors use our site), functional cookies (remember your preferences, such as language and region), and marketing cookies (used to deliver relevant advertising).

sections.heading: 3. Your Consent
sections.body: When you first visit our website, you will be asked to accept or manage non-essential cookies. You can change your preferences at any time via the cookie settings link in the footer.

sections.heading: 4. Managing Cookies in Your Browser
sections.body: Most browsers allow you to refuse or delete cookies through their settings. Please note that blocking essential cookies may affect the functionality of our website.

sections.heading: 5. Third-Party Cookies
sections.body: Some cookies are placed by third-party services we use, such as analytics and payment providers, who have their own privacy and cookie policies.

sections.heading: 6. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Cookie Policy periodically to reflect changes in technology or legislation.

shipping.title: Shipping Information
shipping.intro: WearTry ships to the United States, United Kingdom, and the European Union. Here's what to expect once you place an order.

sections.heading: 1. Processing Time
sections.body: Orders are typically processed and dispatched within 2–5 business days.

sections.heading: 2. Delivery Times
list: United States: 8–15 business days
United Kingdom: 8–15 business days
European Union: 8–15 business days
sections.closing: Delivery times may vary slightly depending on your exact location and customs processing.

sections.heading: 3. Customs and Import Duties
sections.body: International orders may be subject to import duties or taxes set by your country's customs authority. These charges are separate from the item price and shipping cost shown at checkout.
list: For most orders under your country's low-value threshold (for example, €150 in the EU or £135 in the UK), applicable taxes are collected at checkout and no further payment is required on delivery.
Orders above this threshold may require additional payment to customs before delivery. Any such charges are the responsibility of the customer and are not included in our prices.
sections.closing: We recommend checking your local customs regulations if you're ordering a higher-value item.

sections.heading: 4. Tracking Your Order
sections.body: You'll receive a tracking link by email once your order ships. If your package appears delayed, the tracking page is usually the fastest way to check its current status before contacting us.

sections.heading: 5. Lost or Delayed Packages
sections.body: If your tracking shows no movement for more than 10 business days, please contact us at support@weartry.shop and we'll look into it with our shipping partner.

sections.heading: 6. Questions
sections.body: For anything shipping-related, reach out to support@weartry.shop.

about.title: About Us
about.intro: WearTry is an online fashion store built around modern, comfortable clothing you'll actually want to wear every day.

sections.heading: Who We Are
sections.body: WearTry serves customers across the EU, UK and US. Our goal is simple: bring well-made, modern clothing to you at a price that makes sense.

sections.heading: Our Collection
sections.body: We curate our men's, women's and kids' collections through a global partner network, so we can offer a wide, constantly refreshed range of styles.

sections.heading: Our Commitment to Quality
sections.body: Every item goes through a quality check before it ships. If something isn't right, our Return Policy makes it easy to sort out.

sections.heading: Get in Touch
sections.body: Have a question? Reach our team any time through the Contact page — we're here 24/7.

items.question: Hoe kan ik mijn bestelling volgen?
items.answer: Zodra je bestelling is verzonden, ontvang je een trackinglink per e-mail — gebruik deze op elk moment om de bezorgstatus te controleren.

items.question: Hoe lang duurt de verzending?
items.answer: De meeste bestellingen komen binnen 8-15 werkdagen aan, afhankelijk van je locatie.

items.question: Wat is jullie retourbeleid?
items.answer: Je kunt ongedragen artikelen binnen 30 dagen na levering retourneren — bekijk ons retourbeleid voor alle details.

items.question: Welke betaalmethoden accepteren jullie?
items.answer: We accepteren Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay en andere grote kaartnetwerken.

items.question: Hoe vind ik mijn maat?
items.answer: Bekijk de maattabel op elke productpagina — maten staan vermeld in zowel cm als inch.

items.question: Verzenden jullie internationaal?
items.answer: Ja, we verzenden naar de EU, het VK en de VS, met regelmatig nieuwe bestemmingen.

items.question: Kan ik mijn bestelling annuleren of wijzigen?
items.answer: Neem binnen een paar uur na het plaatsen van je bestelling contact met ons op, dan doen we ons best om deze aan te passen of te annuleren voordat hij wordt verzonden.

items.question: Bieden jullie kortingscodes aan?
items.answer: Meld je aan voor onze nieuwsbrief en volg onze promobalk voor seizoensgebonden kortingscodes.

items.question: Van welke materialen zijn jullie producten gemaakt?
items.answer: We gebruiken verantwoord geproduceerde stoffen — bekijk elke productpagina voor de exacte materiaalsamenstelling.

items.question: Hoe kan ik contact opnemen met de klantenservice?
items.answer: Neem op elk moment contact op met ons supportteam via de contactpagina — we reageren meestal binnen 1-2 werkdagen.

items.question: Hoe kan ik mijn bestelling volgen?
items.answer: Zodra je bestelling is verzonden, ontvang je een trackinglink per e-mail — gebruik deze op elk moment om de leveringsstatus te controleren.

items.question: Welke betaalmethoden accepteren jullie?
items.answer: Wij accepteren Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay en andere grote kaartnetwerken.

items.question: Kan ik mijn bestelling annuleren of wijzigen?
items.answer: Neem binnen een paar uur na het plaatsen van je bestelling contact op en wij doen ons best om deze te wijzigen of te annuleren voordat ze wordt verzonden.

items.question: Wanneer komt mijn bestelling aan?
items.answer: Levering naar de VS, VK en EU duurt 8-15 werkdagen, naast 2-5 werkdagen verwerkingstijd — zie onze pagina Verzendinformatie voor details.

items.question: Moet ik invoerrechten betalen?
items.answer: Voor de meeste bestellingen onder de laagwaardegrens van je land worden belastingen bij het afrekenen geïnd en is er niets meer verschuldigd. Bestellingen van hogere waarde kunnen bij levering extra betaling aan de douane vereisen — zie onze pagina Verzendinformatie voor de exacte grenzen.

items.question: Verzenden jullie internationaal?
items.answer: Ja — we verzenden momenteel naar de Verenigde Staten, het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de Europese Unie, met regelmatig nieuwe bestemmingen.

items.question: Hoe retourneer ik een artikel?
items.answer: Mail naar support@weartry.shop met je bestelnummer binnen 30 dagen na levering, mits het artikel ongedragen is met labels nog vast — we bevestigen de volgende stappen en een retouradres.

items.question: Wanneer krijg ik mijn terugbetaling?
items.answer: Zodra we je geretourneerde artikel hebben ontvangen en gecontroleerd, betalen we je oorspronkelijke betaalmethode binnen 5-10 werkdagen terug.

items.question: Wat als mijn artikel beschadigd of verkeerd aankomt?
items.answer: Neem binnen 7 dagen na levering contact op met foto's van het probleem, en wij regelen een vervanging of volledige terugbetaling — inclusief retourverzending — zonder extra kosten voor jou.

items.question: Hoe kies ik de juiste maat?
items.answer: Bekijk de maattabel op elke productpagina — maten staan zowel in cm als inches vermeld, zodat je de beste pasvorm kunt kiezen.

items.question: Uit welke materialen zijn jullie producten gemaakt?
items.answer: We gebruiken verantwoord geproduceerde stoffen — bekijk elke productpagina voor de exacte materiaalsamenstelling.
